title: Smaller CC0 texture libraries (cgbookcase, 3DTextures.me) and ShareTextures' limits
summary: Use cgbookcase and 3DTextures.me CC0 textures, and treat ShareTextures' custom licence (no automated downloads) correctly.
description: Use when Poly Haven and ambientCG lack a material. cgbookcase and 3DTextures.me publish CC0 PBR textures; ShareTextures uses a custom CC0-based licence that forbids automated downloads and redistribution. Explains which to script, which to download by hand, and how to credit.

source.notes: Describes https://www.cgbookcase.com/ (checked 2026-10-10); contains no third-party media.
